Unbounded default AsyncStream buffers: 78 of 78 constructions, 0 bounded.

Task.detached (34) and Task.sleep(nanoseconds:) (18 vs 132 of the for: form) without a reason; unsafe continuations where checked would do (46 of 211); docs that forbid a hatch the code uses (element-x-ios AGENTS.md vs 5 and 16 hatches).
patterns_worth_encoding: private let state: Mutex<State> mutated only in withLock (vapor, swift-foundation); NIOLockedValueBox for pre-Mutex or NIO stacks.
Generic async helpers take 'isolation: isolated (any Actor)? = #isolation' (57 declarations in 12 repos); nonisolated(nonsending) on closure-taking async API.
Enable NonisolatedNonsendingByDefault in the manifest with a docs link (swift-log), but check the build: it broke 2 of 6 packages.
Per-target Swift 5 opt-out with a dated reason and tracker, never package-wide silence (swift-build Package.swift:345, swift-collections, swift-service-lifecycle).
Migration bridge: Swift 5 mode plus StrictConcurrency=complete and upcoming features, then flip (swift-foundation, SwiftPM, SwiftLint).
Conditional Sendable for unsafe-storage containers: extension T: @unchecked Sendable where Element: Sendable.
Discarding task groups for accept loops; withTaskCancellationHandler around a locked state machine; store the Task handle and cancel it on replace or teardown.
sending on results and closure returns instead of transfer boxes; Clock-generic time types for testability.
Library compile-test that generated code survives a consumer's default MainActor (swift-protobuf); defaultIsolation(MainActor) only in app-internal packages next to explicit .swiftLanguageMode(.v6).
Platform libc import blocks with per-OS #if and @preconcurrency import: copy verbatim, not a smell.
contradictions_of_frame: H1 half right: tools version does not predict language mode. Community libraries ship new tools versions with an explicit [.v5] opt-out (Alamofire 6.4, snapshot-testing 6.0). 'Apple/swiftlang is Swift 6' is false for swift-foundation, SwiftPM, swift-format and swift-syntax.

H2: dominance confirmed (755 hatches), but avoidability is overstated by about half (12 of 25). Mutex fits only 4 of 25. 42% of the total is one non-final class hierarchy the compiler will not check, and 'weak let' does not help.

H7: MainActor.run is nearly absent (23 uses, 3 repos) against 614 @MainActor and 76 DispatchQueue.main.async, so any agent habit there is not exemplar-derived. Unstructured Task{} is confirmed but 83% of bare creations sit in two apps; libraries store handles.
H8 narrowly contradicted: default MainActor is set in app-internal packages (IceCubes 9 of 13, element compound-ios), not only app targets, though no published library sets it.

Docs vs config: element-x-ios AGENTS.md says never @unchecked Sendable or nonisolated(unsafe), but the code has 5 and 16. IceCubes CLAUDE.md says avoid Combine, but 24 files import it. Config and code are authoritative.
Mutex is not universal: the NIO stack stays on NIOLockedValueBox (swift-nio 54 vs 1, async-http-client 16 vs 0), while foundation, containerization, vapor and grpc-swift-2 use Mutex.
NonisolatedNonsendingByDefault is early: 7 of 40 repos enable it and it broke 2 of 6 compiled packages, so it must be opt-in with a build check.
